principles: Every decision needs an owner, evidence, and rollback note.
High-impact work waits until accessibility and performance risk are explicit.
Calm UX changes ship in small reversible increments.

decisions.title: Promote Journey Map Builder prototype
decisions.evidence: App registry already includes journey, flow, and friction signals.
decisions.nextAction: Add a local JSON-backed journey stage editor with export-safe state.
decisions.rollback: Keep the existing static app cards as the fallback surface.

decisions.title: Add motion token preview surface
decisions.evidence: Cinematic program already defines quality presets and motion depths.
decisions.nextAction: Expose duration, easing, and reduced-motion presets as inspectable UI.
decisions.rollback: Disable preview panel while preserving the cinematic-program API.

decisions.title: Persist local notes workspace
decisions.evidence: Conversation backlog asks for local storage-backed notes.
decisions.nextAction: Define retention, privacy, and export rules before writing runtime files.
decisions.rollback: Keep notes as client-only draft state until persistence rules are approved.

decisions.title: Evaluate Next.js migration branch
decisions.evidence: Preferred stack mentioned Next.js, but the current foundation is intentionally dependency-free.
decisions.nextAction: Open a scoped evaluation branch only after a dependency budget note.
decisions.rollback: Preserve native Node/static runtime as the release baseline.

decisions.title: Copy raw zip archive into runtime
decisions.evidence: Promotion lab blocks dependency folders, metadata, caches, and wholesale imports.
decisions.nextAction: Promote reviewed ideas only through JSON contracts and small UI/API surfaces.
decisions.rollback: No runtime import; source archive stays review-only.
